Name: Corrosive Splash (Force + Acid)
Trigger: A Force hit lands on a Corroded target
Result: A small splash adds Corrosion to nearby enemies
Limits: Spreads the setup, not a second large burst; the splash cannot trigger another splash

Name: Shocking Impact (Force + Static)
Trigger: A dual-type Force/Static weapon lands a hit
Result: A short local electrical burst around the impact
Limits: Only from a dual-type weapon, never from two separate hits; local burst, no chain

Name: Snot Rocket (Force + Mucus)
Trigger: A Force hit lands on a Snared enemy
Result: Launches it in the hit direction; it leaves one small sticky patch where it lands
Limits: One launch and one patch; no extra stun or bonus damage

Name: Blood Pressure (Force + Blood)
Trigger: A heavy Force hit (the same threshold that knocks off a Shell layer) lands on a bleeding target
Result: The wound bursts for one small area hit
Limits: One burst; no new Bleed stack and no large pool

Name: Soul Purpose (Force + Soul)
Trigger: A Force hit lands on a Possessed enemy
Result: It is launched and damages the first mate it collides with
Limits: One collision; Possessed carries on as normal

Name: Flashover (Force + Fire)
Trigger: A Force hit lands on a burning target
Result: A tongue of flame jumps to one nearby enemy and adds to its Burn bar
Limits: One jump; no chain

Name: Conductive Pool (Acid + Static)
Trigger: A Static hit lands in an Acid Pool
Result: One electrical pulse travels across that pool
Limits: Stays inside the visible pool edge; one pulse per pool

Name: Slick Move (Acid + Mucus)
Trigger: An Acid hit lands on a Mucus patch
Result: The patch is replaced by a short-lived Acid Pool
Limits: Replaces the patch rather than layering two hazards; clear expiry

Name: Caustic Breach (Acid + Blood)
Trigger: An Acid hit lands on a bleeding target
Result: Strips one Shell layer at once
Limits: Defence erosion only: no damage over time, no new wound; does nothing to a target without Shell; once per Bleed

Name: Soul Erosion (Acid + Soul)
Trigger: An Acid hit lands on a Possessed enemy
Result: When Possessed ends, it bursts in a small Acid splash that adds Corrosion to nearby mates
Limits: One splash per Possession; compare with Corrosive Splash in playtest

Name: Premature Evaporation (Acid + Fire)
Trigger: A Fire hit lands on a Corroded target
Result: Consumes the Corrosion in a modest close-range burst
Limits: Never from an Acid Pool by itself; one burst; the Corrosion build-up resets

Name: Sticky Situation (Static + Mucus)
Trigger: A Static hit charges a Mucus patch
Result: The next enemy entering it is briefly shocked
Limits: One trigger per patch; obvious charge cue; no stun loop

Name: Blood Circuit (Static + Blood)
Trigger: A Static hit lands in a blood pool
Result: One arc hits the nearest enemy standing in or beside the pool
Limits: One target; no pulse across the pool and no onward chain (unlike Conductive Pool)

Name: Interference Pattern (Static + Soul)
Trigger: A Static hit lands on a Possessed enemy
Result: Possessed lasts a fixed time longer
Limits: Once per Possession

Name: Arc Flash (Static + Fire)
Trigger: A Static hit lands on a burning target
Result: One short arc jumps to the nearest other enemy
Limits: One jump; no extra Burn, stun or chain

Name: Caught in the Clot (Mucus + Blood)
Trigger: A Mucus hit lands on a blood pool
Result: The pool thickens: the first enemy to cross it is Snared, then the pool is gone
Limits: One catch, then the pool is gone

Name: Held in Suspension (Mucus + Soul)
Trigger: A Mucus hit lands on a Possessed enemy
Result: It is pinned in place for a moment
Limits: Short pin; no extra damage or status

Name: Flammable Mucus (Mucus + Fire)
Trigger: A Fire hit lands on a Mucus patch
Result: The patch flares once: everything standing in it ignites (full Burn bar), then the patch is gone
Limits: One flare; no Mucus slow left behind; the fire cannot relight itself

Name: Blood Donor (Blood + Soul)
Trigger: A Blood hit lands on a Possessed enemy
Result: You heal a small fixed amount
Limits: Once per Possession; no new resource meter

Name: Cauterise (Blood + Fire)
Trigger: A Fire hit lands on a bleeding target
Result: Consumes the Bleed for one immediate burst
Limits: The burst must make up for ending the Bleed; no fresh Burn by default

Name: Spectral Combustion (Soul + Fire)
Trigger: The Soul/Fire Pairing (two weapons you own, both Lv 5+) hits a burning, Possessed enemy
Result: It ignites at once (full Burn bar) and Possessed ends
Limits: Rare by design; the first time it fires, the Scientist gets his Tier 3 line (VOICE_GUIDE.md)

Name: Acid erodes Shell
Result: Corrosion builds to permanent layer loss. Does not disable Membrane or bypass defences generally.

Name: Heavy Force can shed a Shell layer
Result: A thresholded heavy hit (11.3) removes one layer. The same threshold defines a heavy hit for Blood Pressure.

Name: Ordinary hits wear Shell
Result: Each layer has a little health; ordinary qualifying hits wear it slowly.

Name: Membrane resists Force impact
Result: Less drain and less knockback while the Membrane is up.

Name: Static recharges Membrane
Result: +25% capacity, once per 5 s; visible; no supercharge.

Name: Membrane absorbs eligible direct damage
Result: Status prevention depends on whether the applying hit was prevented.

Name: Shell and Burn remain separate
Result: Shell mitigates the physical component, not heat.

Name: Squishy absorbs blunt impact
Result: Proportional; blunt only; no status resistance.

Name: Thorns retaliate once on contact
Result: Once per qualifying Contact hit.

Name: Evasion misses eligible hits
Result: Miss chance on Contact, Projectile and Spread only; a miss prevents the hit and its attached effects.

Name: Membrane and Soul effects
Result: Soul damage is absorbed normally; no bypass. Build-up applies only if the hit isn't blocked.

Name: Snared slows movement
Result: Snared weakens autorun's dodging (movement); it does not change Evasion's miss chance.

Name: Mucus smothers Fire
Result: Becoming Snared clears the Burn bar. A Mucus patch hit by Fire still burns (Flammable Mucus). Water is not a damage type.

Name: Force drives targets into hazards
Result: Knockback into a wall or a world object pays off only on an actual collision (a wall: 40% of the hit, 11.5). No bonus in open space.
